# Vexcalibur Orb v0.1.0

This release publishes `vexcalibur-dev/vexcalibur@0.1.0` from commit [`aaaaaaaaaaaa`](https://github.com/vexcalibur-dev/vexcalibur-orb/commit/aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa).

## Changes

[Release commit](https://github.com/vexcalibur-dev/vexcalibur-orb/commit/aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa)

GitHub Actions publishes the registry entry from this immutable tag after the exact CircleCI pipeline passes. The GitHub Release records the source identity; the CircleCI registry entry is the consumer artifact.
